comments.text:
How would you feel if I wrote a poem about what it's like to live in Alaska, even though I've never visited that place? How would you feel if I made a movie about what it's like to grow up as a black kid in New York, even though I'm white? It would be fucking offensive. It would be disgusting. Even if the art I produced was technically skillful, it would be a lie. Everyone who likes AI art doesn't seem to understand this. Even if AI art appeared technically skillful (it currently doesn't) it would be fundamentally opposed to art. It would be an insincere mimic at best. It would only have value because it copied the value of something else, and it would be inferior to that thing it copied.
Procedurally generated patterns can be beautiful, and if AI ever produces art that is better than an inferior placeholder, it would be something like that; something that explores the parts of existence that aren't necessarily tied to a human life.
